plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, gives his own guess at what happened behind the scenes in 2023, when a proposed law about UFOs lost a clause that would have let the government take UFO technology and materials away from private companies. He says his understanding is that a congressman, Mike Turner, whose region includes Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Dayton, Ohio, worked with aerospace donors and with House leader Mike Johnson to get the clause removed. If true, it would mean defense companies used political influence to keep control of any such materials.
